name: COVID-19 crash (Jan-Mar 2020)
description: Replay of the 2020 pandemic sell-off from the Nifty 50 pre-crash peak to its trough.
rationale: Peak-to-trough of Nifty 50 closes in 2020 in our cache: 12,362.30 on 2020-01-14 to 7,610.25 on 2020-03-23 (-38.44%), 47 sessions, the largest drawdown since 2015. The trough is the session before India's national lockdown was announced (24 Mar 2020).
caveats: A sharp, liquidity-driven crash followed by a fast recovery; the replay ends at the trough and says nothing about recovery time.
Debt fund NAVs in March 2020 also reflect the credit-market stress of that period; the corporate bond fund is slightly negative (-0.4%) over the window.
